ns2:course.label: Careers in Natural Resources
ns2:course.description: (NRES 108) Exploratory course that helps students identify career paths in Natural Resources and Environmental Sciences and plan their college experience to fulfill their future career goals. Job searching, resume writing, and the benefits of internship experiences are included. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: Enrollment in Natural Resources and Environmental Sciences, or Forestry.
